#!/bin/sh
# tvweb managed disabled services
BOOTLOG=/var/lib/webosbrew/tvweb-boot.log
bootlog() { echo "$(date): [up $(cut -d" " -f1 /proc/uptime)s] $*" >>"$BOOTLOG"; }
mkdir /tmp/tvweb-services-ran 2>/dev/null || { bootlog "services: already run this boot"; exit 0; }
bootlog "services: start"
if which systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' >/var/lib/tvweb/service-off; chmod 755 /var/lib/tvweb/service-off
  printf 'process.exit(0);\n' >/var/lib/tvweb/service-off.js
  off() { case "$1" in *.js) s=/var/lib/tvweb/service-off.js ;; *) s=/var/lib/tvweb/service-off ;; esac
    grep -q " $1 " /proc/mounts || mount --bind "$s" "$1"; }
  jail() { j=/var/palm/jail/$2; [ -e "$3" ] || return
    grep -q " $j/usr " /proc/mounts || /usr/bin/jailer -t "$1" -i "$2" -p /usr /bin/true >/dev/null 2>&1
    grep -q " $j/usr " /proc/mounts && off "$j$3"; }
  jail "native_mvpd" "lg.thinqai.adapter" "/usr/sbin/lg.thinqai.adapter" &
  off "/usr/sbin/com.webos.service.camera2"
  off "/usr/sbin/rdxd"
  off "/usr/sbin/lg.thinqai.adapter"
  wait
  bootlog "services: stubs bound"
  systemctl stop "com.webos.service.camera.service" "rdxd.service" 2>/dev/null
elif which initctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  initctl stop "rdxd" 2>/dev/null
fi
bootlog "services: stopped"
